section1.title: What is Dyslexia?
section1.text: Dyslexia is a learning difference that affects reading, writing, and spelling. It may sometimes affect memory and organization, but it does not affect intelligence.

fact3.label: Not Related to Intelligence:
fact3.text: Most affected individuals have normal intelligence

section3.title: Why Is It Positive for the Child to Know Their Condition?
section3.intro: Knowing the real reason for the difficulty relieves the child and protects them from self-blame.
section3.benefit3: Helps the child understand their learning style
section3.highlight: Dyslexia is a learning difference, not a failure.
